{{Quote|You can say it. A flimsi box sealed with vartik tree sap would be more efficient to hold a Force-user than what we've got.|Abara Mun, to Luke and Ben Skywalker|<ref name="Allies" />}}
'''Vartik trees''' were a type of [[Tree/Legends|tree]] that produced [[Sap/Legends|sap]].<ref name="Allies" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] [[Police officer/Legends|detention officer]] [[Abara Mun]] agreed to turn over [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ben Skywalker]], [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Vestara Khai]], and former [[Jedi Candidate]] [[Dyon Stadd]] into [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] custody. As she let them leave, she commented that the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine's]] [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|security forces]] were not equipped to hold [[Force-sensitive/Legends|users]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], comparing their [[Treema Courthouse and Detention Area|facilities]] to a [[Flimsiplast/Legends|flimsi]] box sealed with vartik tree sap.<ref name="Allies" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vartik trees were mentioned in the novel ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]'', which was written by [[Christie Golden]] and published in [[2010]] as the fifth volume in the ''[[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi]]'' series.<ref name="Allies" />
